prompt: We stayed at a lake cabin in Finland in August. Mikko, a local fisherman, told me he (to be) surprised by a friendly seal near his boat. Then he asked me (to pass) him my camera.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени глагол be сдвигается в was (или had been). Просьба после ask + дополнение оформляется инфинитивом с to (asked me to pass).

prompt: During an open day at a fire station in Vienna, a firefighter spoke to our class. He told us that his team (to save) a small duck from a street drain. Then he warned the youngest children (not / to stand) near the big red lorry. Everyone clapped at the end.
explanation_ru: Действие в прошлом до момента рассказа передаётся через Past Perfect (had saved, в разговорной речи допустимо saved). Запрет после warn строится с частицей not перед to: not to stand.

prompt: After a lively dinner in Rome, our host Lorenzo laughed about his early cooking disasters. He admitted (to ruin) his first tiramisu, which turned as hard as a brick. I asked him (what / he / to put) inside it. Before we left, he promised (to send) us his new recipe.
explanation_ru: После admit используется герундий (ruining), а после promise — инфинитив с to (to send). В косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did и сдвиг времени (what he had put).

prompt: Back at the main train station in Barcelona, Carmen rushed straight to the ticket desk. She complained that someone (to switch) the labels on her suitcase during the trip. The officer asked her (she / to check) the lost-luggage office. He also advised her (to leave) her phone number on a form.
explanation_ru: В жалобе о более раннем событии Past Simple сдвигается в Past Perfect (had switched). Общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а совет после advise требует to-инфинитива.

prompt: Early in the morning, a journalist visited Hamish's dairy farm in New Zealand to write a local feature. Over tea, Hamish mentioned that one clever cow (to unlock) the wooden gate before sunrise and led the whole herd onto the main road. The reporter wondered (how long / it / to take) to bring all the animals back. Laughing, the farmer warned her (not / to drop) her lunch bag near the fence, because the brown cow (will / to steal) it if it got the chance.
explanation_ru: Для прошлых событий до момента разговора используется Past Perfect, а в косвенном вопросе — прямой порядок слов (how long it had taken). После warn ставится not to-инфинитив, а will в условном предложении переходит в would.

prompt: Before her trip out of Buenos Aires, my aunt called my cousin Sofia. She reminded Sofia (to water) the plants on the balcony. She also told her that the spare key (will / to be) in the kitchen drawer. Sofia wrote both things down on a yellow note.
explanation_ru: Глагол remind с дополнением требует инфинитива с to (reminded Sofia to water). Будущее время с will после told в прошедшем сдвигается в would be.

prompt: Minutes before the evening film ended in Lagos, the whole cinema went completely dark. Tunde, who ran the equipment room, explained to the manager that a sudden power cut (to stop) the screen right at the final kiss. The manager asked him (the lights / will / to come) back on soon. Tunde replied that he (can / not / to promise) anything, so they handed out free tickets to use the following weekend.
explanation_ru: Событие до объяснения передаётся Past Perfect (had stopped). Общий вопрос строится с if/whether и переходом will в would, а can not в прошедшем плане становится couldn't.

prompt: On my first shift at a small café in Milan, I felt quite nervous. The manager, Giulia, told me (to wash) all the white cups before seven o'clock. She also explained that the coffee machine (to need) five minutes to get hot. I finished everything in time for the first customers.
explanation_ru: Поручение после tell + дополнение оформляется инфинитивом с to (told me to wash). Постоянное свойство машины можно передать со сдвигом (needed) или без него (needs).

prompt: Ten minutes before our friend's birthday surprise in Cape Town, Thabo sent a message to our group chat. He told everyone (to hide) behind the big sofa as soon as the lift opened. He also warned us (not / to speak) until the living-room lights came on. I asked him (what / we / should / to do) with the huge bag of balloons, and he laughed.
explanation_ru: Команда и запрет требуют инфинитива (to hide, not to speak). Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не меняется, а в вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов (what we should do).

prompt: After the morning check-up at a children's clinic in Helsinki, Nurse Aino smiled at my sister. She said that a cheeky little boy (to hide) his blue sock inside her desk drawer earlier in the week. When my sister asked (she / to find) it right away, Aino laughed and admitted (to search) the whole room before opening the top drawer. My nephew thought the story was hilarious.
explanation_ru: О произошедшем ранее событии сообщают через Past Perfect (had hidden). Общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а после admit нужен герундий (searching).

prompt: During our summer internship at a castle library in Edinburgh, we helped sort old maps. The head librarian, Fiona, told us we (must / to wear) white cotton gloves before opening the cabinet. She also reminded us (not / to use) camera flashes, explaining that bright light (to damage) old paper. Before leaving, she asked (we / will / to lock) the tall drawer when we finished.
explanation_ru: Обязанность must в прошедшем контексте переходит в had to, а запрет после remind строится через not to use. Общеизвестный факт может оставаться в Present Simple (damages), а общий вопрос с will использует if/whether и would.

prompt: Around the glowing campsite fire in southern Morocco, our guide Tariq entertained everyone with stories from previous tours. He recalled that a curious camel (to walk) straight into the kitchen tent one evening and eaten all the sweet dates. When a tourist wondered (what / the cook / to do) upon discovering the empty shelves, Tariq laughed and suggested (to keep) our own snacks zipped inside our backpacks overnight. Naturally, nobody left even a biscuit outside their tent after that.
explanation_ru: Однородное сказуемое and eaten требует Past Perfect в первой части (had walked). Косвенный вопрос строится без инверсии и без did, а глагол suggest управляет герундием (keeping), а не инфинитивом.

prompt: Señora Ruiz stood on the noisy factory floor in Monterrey. She told the new workers ___ and asked if everyone could hear her.
options: wear their helmets at all times
that wear their helmets at all times
to wear their helmets at all times
wearing their helmets at all times
explanation_ru: При передаче приказа после tell + дополнение всегда ставится инфинитив с частицей to (told the new workers to wear). Частая ошибка — пропускать to или использовать that/герундий.

prompt: At an open-air art park in Seoul, a strong wind blew across the hill. Joon, the park guard, asked two teenagers (to step) back from a tall metal sculpture. He explained that the heavy metal frame (can / to fall) loose in strong gusts. The boys apologised (to stand) too close and promised to stay on the path.
explanation_ru: Вежливая просьба после ask требует инфинитива с to, а модальный глагол can после explained переходит в could. Глагол apologise всегда требует предлога for и герундия (apologised for standing).

prompt: In a warm village hall in northern Scotland, Mateo played a slow violin tune. After the song, he told the crowd that his grandmother (to teach) him that melody years before. Then he asked us (we / to know) the name of the tune. Everyone smiled and asked for one more song.
explanation_ru: Событие, случившееся задолго до концерта, передаётся через Past Perfect (had taught). Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится союзом if/whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом know в knew.

prompt: Twenty minutes before our school concert in Busan, everyone met in the music room. Our teacher, Min-ji, asked the choir (to sing) a few soft notes to warm up. She also said the first group (will / to begin) at six o'clock. We took a deep breath and walked out together.
explanation_ru: Просьба после ask + дополнение оформляется через to-инфинитив (asked the choir to sing). После said в прошедшем времени глагол will сдвигается в would.

prompt: Over hot coffee at our windy campsite in Patagonia, Valeria is telling me about her early hike. She says that a massive block of ice (to break) off the glacier at six o'clock with a noise like thunder. When I ask her (she / to manage) to film it, she admits (to drop) her phone into the snow in shock. Thankfully, the screen survived without a scratch.
explanation_ru: Глаголы речи стоят в настоящем времени (is telling, says, ask, admits), поэтому сдвиг времён не нужен — остаётся Past Simple (broke, managed). После admit требуется герундий (dropping).

prompt: Erik hurried into the back room of the Stockholm furniture shop because a customer was waiting by the entrance. He asked the delivery team to load the grey sofa onto the van at once and wondered ___.
options: where had they put the cushions
where they had put the cushions
where did they put the cushions
where they have put the cushions
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после wondered нужен прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного did и сдвиг времени в прошлое (where they had put). Варианты с инверсией и Present Perfect ошибочны.

prompt: Before the youth race in Addis Ababa, the running track was very busy. Coach Dawit told the younger runners (to stay) in the outside lane during warm-up. He also explained that the main race (will / to start) ten minutes later. Everyone nodded and stretched their legs.
explanation_ru: Указание после tell + дополнение передаётся инфинитивом с to (told them to stay). Будущее время с will после explained в прошедшем переходит в would.

prompt: Halfway through our robot club meeting in Osaka, one wheel on the small machine began spinning wildly. Our leader, Hana, ordered everyone (to turn) off the power and step back from the table. She then asked Kenji (he / to change) the speed code earlier. He denied (to touch) the laptop and pointed at a loose wire instead.
explanation_ru: После order используется to-инфинитив (ordered everyone to turn), а после deny — герундий (denied touching), но не инфинитив. Общий вопрос вводится через if/whether со сдвигом в Past Perfect.

prompt: At a car park gate in Singapore, the attendant said to a driver, "Please move your car back a little. Do you have your monthly pass?" Which sentence reports this correctly?
options: The attendant asked the driver move his car back and asked did he have his monthly pass.
The attendant told the driver moving his car back and asked if he has his monthly pass.
The attendant asked the driver to move his car back and asked if he had his monthly pass.
The attendant said the driver to move his car back and asked whether had he his monthly pass.
explanation_ru: Просьба передаётся конструкцией ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив, а общий вопрос — через if с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом have в had. В остальных вариантах пропущено to, нарушен порядок слов или ошибочно употреблён глагол say.

prompt: Everyone in the hostel lounge in Cusco was swapping funny travel disasters over tea. Priya told us that she (to miss) a flight to Madrid because of one lost trainer. When somebody asked her (where / she / to find) it in the end, she laughed and confessed it had been inside her own pillowcase. She advised all of us (to check) our beds before packing.
explanation_ru: Прошлые события в рассказе переходят в Past Perfect (had missed, had found). В косвенном вопросе нет did и сохраняется прямой порядок слов, а после advise ставится to-инфинитив.

prompt: Right after the graduation ceremony in Seoul, Ji-hoon made his family laugh with a story from his first year. He admitted (to fail) a big practice test in autumn, yet somehow he had still received a passing mark. When his uncle asked him (how / that / to happen), Ji-hoon explained that the computer system (to add) his points twice by mistake. Laughing, he promised (not / to count) on a computer error at his new job.
explanation_ru: После admit нужен герундий (failing), а после promise — отрицательный инфинитив not to count. Косвенный вопрос и объяснение причины используют прямой порядок слов и Past Perfect.

prompt: Last Saturday, we chatted with Tiago, the local lifeguard, at a small beach café in Portugal. He told us that a huge wave (to pull) a man's umbrella straight out to sea during a storm. One customer asked him (the owner / to run) after it, and Tiago laughed before warning us (not / to sit) too close to the water at high tide. Everyone smiled and moved their chairs back.
explanation_ru: Событие из прошлого передаётся через Past Perfect (had pulled). Общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether без did, а предупреждение после warn строится через not to sit.

prompt: Near the end of the office party in Sydney, our sales director Lachlan picked up the microphone for a short speech. He revealed that the office cat (to send) a line of random letters to a major client while walking across his keyboard. When someone asked (the client / to complain), Lachlan grinned and said she had actually suggested (to hire) the cat as his assistant. The whole room cheered and raised their glasses to the sleeping pet.
explanation_ru: После глагола revealed в прошедшем времени используется Past Perfect (had sent), а в общем вопросе — союз if/whether с прямым порядком слов. После suggest ставится герундий (hiring), а не инфинитив.

prompt: Walking through a narrow market street in Marrakesh, Nadia stopped to buy oranges. The stall owner politely asked her (to move) her bicycle off the path. He explained that a delivery cart (can / not / to get) past it. Nadia smiled and parked the bike beside the wall.
explanation_ru: Вежливая просьба после ask + дополнение оформляется инфинитивом с to (asked her to move). После explained в прошедшем времени отрицание с can сдвигается в couldn't get.

prompt: While staying at a beach hotel in Thailand last winter, we heard a wild story from Somsak, the owner. He told us that a monkey had grabbed the room keys from the front desk ___ and warned us to lock our balconies.
options: this morning
today morning
morning before
that morning
explanation_ru: При пересказе прошлой истории указатель времени this morning меняется на that morning. Оставлять this morning в рассказе о прошлой зиме — частая ошибка.

prompt: Every Sunday morning, our community garden in Cardiff fills up with local volunteers. Gareth, the group leader, asks two helpers (to carry) the heavy soil bags to the back plot. He says the sky (to look) dark over the hills. Because of that, he suggests (to finish) the planting before lunch.
explanation_ru: После ask используется to-инфинитив, а после suggest — герундий (finishing). Так как глагол речи says стоит в настоящем времени, сдвиг времени не происходит (looks).

prompt: Sitting out in the warm backyard in Brisbane, Grandpa Colin loved telling stories to his grandchildren. He told them that a bright green parrot (to fly) through the kitchen window one morning and taken his silver spoon. When my little sister asked him (he / to catch) the thief, he laughed and added that the bird had simply refused (to give) it back from the top of the mango tree.
explanation_ru: Второе причастие and taken требует Past Perfect в первом глаголе (had flown). Общий вопрос строится через if/whether без did, а после refuse всегда идёт инфинитив с to (to give).

prompt: Once the street food festival in Thessaloniki ended, Nikos told a friend, "My cheese stall sold out in two hours! Next year I will bring twice as much." Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: Nikos told his friend that his cheese stall had sold out in two hours and that he would bring twice as much the following year.
Nikos told to his friend that his cheese stall sold out in two hours and that he will bring twice as much next year.
Nikos said his friend that my cheese stall had sold out in two hours and that he would bring twice as much the following year.
Nikos told his friend that his cheese stall has sold out in two hours and that he would bring twice as much tomorrow.
explanation_ru: В верном варианте соблюдены сдвиги времён (sold out -> had sold out, will -> would), замена местоимения (my -> his) и указателя времени (next year -> the following year). В других вариантах допущены типичные ошибки: told to, said his friend или отсутствие сдвига.

prompt: Showing us around her new flat in Kuala Lumpur, Aisha paused beside a sunny spare bedroom. She explained that before she moved in, a stray cat (to live) quietly inside that room for weeks. When I asked her (why / she / not / to call) an animal shelter, she laughed and admitted (to fall) in love with the cat on the very first evening. A minute later, a fat ginger cat wandered out and curled up on my shoes.
explanation_ru: Длительное действие до переезда передаётся через Past Perfect Continuous (had been living) или Past Perfect. В отрицательном косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов, а после admit нужен герундий (falling).

prompt: When I arrived at the dental clinic in Lisbon, the waiting room was quiet. The receptionist politely asked me (to fill) in a short form with my address. She also told me that the doctor (will / to see) me in ten minutes. I sat down in one of the green chairs and picked up a magazine.
explanation_ru: Просьба после ask + дополнение оформляется инфинитивом с to (asked me to fill). Будущее время с will после глагола told в прошедшем переходит в would see.

prompt: Standing at the top of the lighthouse museum in Maine, retired keeper Arthur looked out over the rocky bay. He told our group that a fierce storm (to smash) the main lamp while his boat was still offshore. When a visitor asked (how / they / to reach) the harbour in complete darkness, Arthur explained that a passing ship had guided them back with its horn. Before we walked down the stairs, he advised us (never / to ignore) a sudden change in the wind.
explanation_ru: Событие из прошлого передаётся через Past Perfect (had smashed), а косвенный вопрос требует прямого порядка слов без did (how they had reached). В отрицательном совете после advise наречие never ставится перед частицей to.

prompt: Two days before we flew to Tokyo, our host Daiki sent a detailed welcome email. He reminded us to take off our shoes at the entrance, asked us to leave the flat key in a wooden bowl by the door, and politely suggested ___.
options: messaging him as soon as our train arrived
to message him as soon as our train arrived
us to message him as soon as our train arrived
messaging him as soon as our train will arrive
explanation_ru: После suggest используется герундий (messaging), а не инфинитив с to и не конструкция с дополнением us to do. В придаточном времени после as soon as не употребляется will.

prompt: Back in the Lagos taxi office, Chidi admitted to his boss, "I took a passenger to the wrong street earlier, so I refused to charge him and offered to drive him back for free." Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: Chidi admitted to take a passenger to the wrong street, adding that he had refused charging him and offered driving him back for free.
Chidi admitted taking a passenger to the wrong street, adding that he had refused to charge him and offered to drive him back for free.
Chidi admitted taking a passenger to the wrong street, adding that he had refused charging him and offered that he drove him back for free.
Chidi admitted to have taken a passenger to the wrong street, adding that he refused to charge him and offered him driving back for free.
explanation_ru: Глагол admit требует герундия (admitted taking), тогда как refuse и offer требуют инфинитива с to (refused to charge, offered to drive). В остальных вариантах перепутаны модели управления этих глаголов.
